title: Personal Loans Courtesy Waivers: Amount Figure After an Earlier Courtesy Waiver
content:
## Rule

The waiver form of a Personal Loans courtesy waiver sets the figure the courtesy share is taken from in place of the unpaid part of the fee, and follows the loan's latest earlier courtesy waiver, counted in whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the request date:

- one fewer than 12 whole months before means the figure is the unpaid part less 5.00 USD, never below zero;
- one 12 to 23 whole months before means the figure is 0.9 of the unpaid part;
- none fewer than 24 whole months before means the figure is the whole unpaid part.

The amount waived is that figure times the courtesy share, rounded to the cent once, at the end; a waiver that works out to 0.00 is not granted.

| Latest earlier courtesy waiver on the loan | Figure |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 whole months before the request date | unpaid part less 5.00, not below zero |
| 12 to 23 whole months before | 0.9 of the unpaid part |
| 24 or more whole months before, or none | the whole unpaid part |

## Cases (hypothetical, request on 8 September, unpaid part 30.00)

- Earlier courtesy waiver on 9 September of the year before: 11 whole months: figure 25.00.
- Earlier courtesy waiver on 8 September of the year before: 12 whole months: figure 27.00.
- Earlier courtesy waiver on 8 September two years before: 24 whole months: figure 30.00.
- Unpaid part 4.00 with an earlier waiver 3 months before: 4.00 less 5.00 is below zero, so 0.00, and no waiver is granted.
